f.statement: If the ESG is not functional for more than 48 hours, FDA communicates procedures via the ESG listserv; if those procedures are followed, the ICSRs or attachments should not be resubmitted via the ESG once it is functional. rows.quote: If the ESG is not functional for more than 48 hours, the FDA ESG email distribution list (listserv) will be used to communicate procedures on how to proceed with your submission. If you follow these procedures, it is important that you do not resubmit the ICSRs or ICSR attachment(s) to FDA using the ESG when it becomes functional. Note that when you follow the alternate submission method, the official FDA receipt date of the ICSRs or ICSR attachment(s) will be the date when the submission is received by the CBER Document Control Room (DCC) or VAERS program (for example, if the submission is faxed, the receipt date will be the date on the timestamp of the successful fax).

f.statement: Under 21 CFR 600.80(c)(2), postmarketing periodic safety reports must be submitted at prescribed intervals; each must contain a descriptive portion and the ICSRs for all adverse experiences other than 15-day Alert reports and their follow-ups for the reporting period (i.e., serious and expected, or nonserious).

dates.quote: These requirements became effective as of June 10, 2015.
dates.timing_note: Effective date of the June 10, 2014 final rule (79 FR 33072) restated in this guidance (August 2015). For human drugs and nonvaccine biologics the compliance date was later delayed to September 8, 2015 (see the April 2022 PMSR electronic guidance); this guidance concerns vaccines. Held below 90 because the date belongs to the rule.
